title: Normalized raw rational module realization data
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension, with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible at every stalk. Work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ with its actual quotient projections [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let $\mathcal C_X$ be the full bounded constructible complete integral category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Write $Q:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=\mathcal C_X[1/\varpi]$ for raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Use the continuous coefficient sheaves $A_X^c(U)=C(|U|,A)$, $E_X(U)=C(|U|,E)$ and their actual coefficient inclusions and inverse images [def-sfb-continuous-coefficient-pullback-maps], with constant module models as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module].

Define a rational module realization datum to be the following data and equations, with no existence assertion. It contains ring isomorphisms $b:B_X\simeq A_X^c$, $q_n:(A/\varpi^{n+1})_X\simeq(A/\varpi^{n+1})_X^c$ for $n\geq0$, and $e:A_X^c[1/\varpi]\simeq E_X$. Each $q_n$ sends a sheafified constant section to that same constant function. For every section $s$ of $A_X^c$ and every point $x$ of a site object, the function obtained by $b^{-1}$, the $n$th quotient projection and $q_n$ has value $s(x)\bmod\varpi^{n+1}$. The map $e$ is normalized on integral numerators. The datum contains the scalar inclusion $a:A_X^c\to E_X$ with $a(s)(x)=s(x)$, and for every locally closed immersion $h:S\to X$ coefficient isomorphisms $h^{-1}A_X^c\simeq A_S^c$ and $h^{-1}E_X\simeq E_S$, normalized by precomposition on functions, and an inclusion $a_S$ with the same pointwise normalization, such that the square with $a$ and $a_S$ commutes.

The module category over $E_X$ is equipped with its $E$-linear structure normalized by $(c f)_U(x)=c_U f_U(x)$, where $c_U$ is the actual constant section. For $\alpha=b\,;\,a$, the ordinary extension of scalars along $\alpha$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits; its derived extension $F_X=E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}-$ has a specified integer shift comparison and is triangulated. For every $r\in\mathbf Z$ the datum includes the natural isomorphism $H^rF_X\simeq (E_X\otimes_{B_X}-)H^r$. For every $K\in\mathcal C_X$, $F_XK$ is bounded and each $H^r(F_XK)$ has a finite locally closed stratification on whose strata it is pro-etale locally finite free over $E_X$.

Finally the datum contains an additive $E$-linear functor $J_X:\mathcal R_X\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(E_X))$, a specified comparison with all integer shifts, and preservation of distinguished triangles, satisfying $J_X(QK)=F_XK$ on objects and $J_X(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_X(f)$ on every fraction, with transport by the specified object equalities. For every finitely presented $A$-module $N$, it includes an isomorphism $(E_X\otimes_{B_X}-)(B_X\otimes_A N)\simeq E_X\otimes_E(E\otimes_A N)$ of ordinary module sheaves and witnesses that $E\otimes_A N$ is finite and free over $E$. No flatness of $N$, full faithfulness, essential surjectivity, Karoubi completion or scalar-tower coherence is part of this definition. All coefficient types use the canonical lifts to the site coefficient universe.
